what_they_do: Pensar builds AI agents that continuously pentest and patch software, replacing point-in-time manual penetration tests and static scanners. Their agent (Apex) runs black-box adversarial testing against a company's full attack surface plus runtime validation on every pull request, chains discoveries into exploitable attack paths with proof-of-concept scripts, and produces verified, auto-generated patches rather than just a findings list. The workflow it displaces is the traditional annual/quarterly pentest engagement staffed by human consultants (and static AppSec tooling that only flags issues without fixing them).
theme_fit_rationale: Pensar directly displaces the labor of traditional pentesting firms and human security consultants with an AI-native, outcome-based service (verified fixed vulnerabilities, not just a report) — the core Theme 6 pattern (use case list explicitly names insurance/security-adjacent professional services). Secondary fit with Theme 9 because Pensar also ships an AI Agent Security Scanner aimed at vulnerabilities specific to AI agent applications, i.e. security infrastructure built for a world where agents are both the tester and part of the attack surface.
workflow_artifacts: runtime validation results on pull requests (CI/CD gate)
